detours.why: Kinard Hall's nearest mapped way is the drive on its north side by the North Parking Structure; no mapped path links it east to the residence halls, so walks go round by the garage loop.
No mapped path runs directly from Burns Hall south-east to Meek Hall; the walk goes round by the road on the east.
No mapped path runs south-west from the residential colleges across the lawn to the Honors College; walks go round by the roads to the north and west.
